open_items: Magentic and Sightline are taken from the firm's news-index page (post titles, dates, quoted lines); the Medium posts returned HTTP 403, so amounts and co-investors are not recorded. Magentic's $5.5M amount appears only in search summaries. Dates are post dates.
Newer Westly posts exist (Noetive seed, 2026-09-16; Tenet, 2026-06-17; Generalist, 2026-06-23) but the Medium pages were not fetchable.

Leads' $160M (2013) fund not verified: only the 2024 seed fund and Fund IV ($312M, for A, B and C rounds, per the press release) appear on fetched pages. Homepage states '$800M+' AUM and 5 funds raised. Stage list for series_a/series_b is inferred from the Fund IV description and the Squint Series B.
Check size not stated. Squint HQ not stated on the Fortune page. Sector 'mobility_ev' and others come from the homepage sector list, which is a general list rather than a seed-fund description.
